ingredients: Lowfat yogurt (cultured pasteurized nonfat milk, cream), evaporated cane sugar, black cherries, water, fruit pectin, cherry juice concentrate, locust bean gum, natural flavors, lemon juice concentrate. contains live and active cultures: s. thermophilus, l. bulgaricus, l. acidophilus, bifidus and l. casei.
